These form a dual structure—filtering and selection—that ensures robustness against noise and overfitting. Failure modes include false positives from weak signals, over-reliance on market consensus, and exclusion of valid but under-resourced groups. The system balances exploration and exploitation through adaptive thresholds and dynamic group inclusion criteria.
